2026-11-23HC, PHACQuarantine ActMinimizing the Risk of Exposure to Ebola Disease in Canada Order, 2026, No. 4Minimizing the Risk of Exposure to Ebola Disease in Canada Order, 2026, No. 4 in order to (1) (1) replace the current Public Health Agency of Canada Order, maintaining the existing entry prohibition and isolation and quarantine requirements, as well as the limited exceptions; and (2) include a number of minor revisions for operational clarity.N/A
subject: Minimizing the Risk of Exposure to Ebola Disease in Canada Order, 2026, No. 4
precis: Minimizing the Risk of Exposure to Ebola Disease in Canada Order, 2026, No. 4 in order to (1) (1) replace the current Public Health Agency of Canada Order, maintaining the existing entry prohibition and isolation and quarantine requirements, as well as the limited exceptions; and (2) include a number of minor revisions for operational clarity.
